Every autumn millions of salmon run up the rivers of British Columbia to spawn. But after months of drought the guys are forced to venture deep into the mountains to find the fish.
Native to the Indo-Pacific but accidentally introduced to the Caribbean, Lionfish are decimating the island ecosystems.

Freediver and spear-fisherman Jay wants the boys to join him in taking on a mighty Giant Moray Eel. They seek out the help of world renowned freedivers, the nomadic Sea Gypsies, to learn how to take on these seas, and these huge fish.

In this episode the team's mission takes them to the barren icy mountains of Patagonia, in search of a deep-sea delicacy. The Patagonian Toothfish sells for $100 per kilo in the fish markets of North America.
The remaining survivalists push themselves to their physical limits as fish becomes scarce. But one participant takes it too far, reaching the breaking point and risking organ failure.
The remaining participants, short on food, risk death in their attempt to triumph. Only one survivalist will be able to endure the wilds of Patagonia and take home the $500,000 prize.
After one of the longest tests of endurance in series history, the participants of Alone's third season reunite to discuss their experiences, genius creations, and reveal never before seen footage.
Meet the ten brave participants on ALONE Season 3 and learn about the extreme location at the edge of the world.

Seven family member pairs are dropped miles apart on Northern Vancouver Island and must find each other. To win the $500,000 prize, they must survive the island's unforgiving terrain and deadly predators.

As their teammates attempt to set up camp, the hikers find that the terrain is even more punishing when on the move. The island beats one pair into submission, and another grapples with a devastating accident.
On Vancouver Island, a seriously injured participant weighs the risks of seeking medical help and sacrificing his shot at $500,000.
Desperation sinks in as the hikers struggle to make the final push to their teammates. Exhaustion leads one participant straight into the path of a predator, and into a dangerous confrontation.
Thom Hunt challenges himself to locate and catch four UK species in one week.
